items.claim: Slot-lookup dependency carries no `scene`, so boolean operands are outlined by the default painters
Trimmed stroke's pick outline memoized without the silhouette's generation or key, so it goes stale
items.note: The local silhouette it trims is now also built at the pick's view scale.

items.claim: `buildSceneLayer` with a `toPose` derives paths from local poses, not world poses
Group's drawn box reaches over hidden or consumed members
`defaultPaintBounds` boxes a labeled group without its label when a painter claiming groups sets `drawsLabel`
items.note: Both functions now pick the painter through one `painterOf` helper.

items.claim: End-anchored HUDs pinned against the window width including the scrollbar
items.note: The fix is in `useHostAnchor.ts`, which feeds `hostAnchor.ts`.

items.claim: insertPreview `extras` missing or not an object throws
Main canvas cull ignores a pose override's `path`, unlike the scene view
items.note: Both culls now go through one shared `sceneCullPaintBounds`, so they can't differ again.

items.claim: `<Canvas>` keeps the replaced `<canvas>` registered after a `worker` toggle
items.note: The registration now follows whatever element the canvas currently has, checked at every commit.

items.claim: `<SceneViewCanvas>` has no `redrawOn`, so an `alphaFor` that reads outside state goes stale
items.note: It's added to both the page path and the worker path. This is new API, so the changeset is `minor`.

items.claim: `watchThemeOf` misses token overrides set inline or in a stylesheet in `<head>`
A tile of a canvas already painting with WebGPU builds a WebGPU renderer and erases its co-tenants
items.note: The tile now gets no renderer and warns once. I kept this refusal separate from the canvas's general refused state, so the canvas can still paint whole. No `docs/unruled.md` entry: this enforces what the `CanvasBackend` doc already promises.

items.claim: Content bounds skip a hidden-layer root's shown subtree and its copies
Gesture reason never shows for a gesture inside a `<CanvasView>`
items.note: Each view registration now carries `worldToCanvas`, and `<GestureReason>` reads every registered view's dispatcher and places the reason through that view's camera and rect.

items.claim: `~*` / `~x` capped below 1.0.0 instead of matching any version
`inkBoxes` reads member world poses from the shown scene, not the document
`defaultDrawOne` puts a label at (NaN, NaN) on a non-rect `Path` pose
items.note: The label now anchors on the path's bounds. A pose with no position gets no label.
